projects.name: American Express Global Business Travel
details: • Worked as part of an Agile product team, driving requirement refinement, feature creation, prioritization, and backlog
grooming in JIRA, ensuring alignment with business objectives and sprint goals by created crisp BRDs and FRDs.
• Used Miro boards during PI Planning to collaborate with product, engineering, data, and operations teams, visualizing
dependencies, breaking epics into features, and aligning deliverables for upcoming quarters.
• Performed deep data analysis using SQL on AWS Redshift to validate business logic, identify trends in travel/spend
patterns, and support decision-making for enterprise travel solutions.
• Developed and enhanced Power BI dashboards to track KPIs like spend optimization, policy compliance, traveller
trends, and process performance, enabling data-backed product improvements.
• Led UAT planning, test case creation, and defect triage, ensuring user readiness and high-quality releases for key product
enhancements across global markets.

projects.name: S&P Global
details: • Acted as a core member of the Agile product team, driving user story development, acceptance criteria definition, and
backlog prioritization in Azure DevOps (ADO) for Capital IQ Pro enhancements.
• Facilitated PI Planning sessions using Miro, designing product workflows, mapping feature dependencies, and aligning
cross-functional teams on quarterly objectives and delivery milestones.
• Utilized SQL to validate financial datasets, support impact assessments, and ensure high-quality data for market
intelligence workflows along with API (JSON, XML) for data validations.
• Created internal analytics dashboards and product usage insights using Power BI, enabling data-driven product decisions
and enhancement prioritization.
• Led end-to-end UAT cycles, coordinating with QA, product managers, and engineering to ensure stable releases,
accurate data delivery, and improved platform usability with zero major production defects.
• Used Pandas and Numpy to gain insights on market trends analysis for top listed companies on Capital IQ Pro.
Leveraged components like Bid Price, Ask Price etc to showcase field wise trends using Matplotlib
